plain_statement: On fifteen inputs a_v, b_v, c_v (inputs v, 5 + v, 10 + v), v = 0..4, the function OR over the 5-cycle's edges uv of (MAJ(a_u, b_u, c_u) AND MAJ(a_v, b_v, c_v)) (MAJ: at least two of three true) has no monotone formula of depth at most 6. A monotone formula: a tree of fan-in-two AND and OR gates over the inputs, no NOT, no constants; depth at most d is said as: the function lies in level d of every family of sets of functions that holds the inputs at level 0, keeps each level in the next, and puts the AND and the OR of two level-k functions in level k + 1. Conjecture.
title: Probe: with each input of the 5-cycle replaced by a majority of three fresh inputs, monotone fan-in-two AND/OR formulas need depth at least 7
